claims.claim: Protocol triangle MCP/A2A/AG-UI roles
AG-UI request/response: RunAgentInput POST, SSE stream of typed events
RunAgentInput JSON shape and fields threadId, runId, messages, tools, context, state, forwardedProps
tools are frontend tools: application executes
Example SSE events RUN_STARTED ... RUN_FINISHED
Adapter emits lifecycle/text/tool/state snapshot/step events; does not emit state deltas, message snapshots, reasoning, activity, subagent
RUN_FINISHED with interrupt outcome when stopped for outside input
sdk/agui bridges SDK conversations; converters and EventAdapter
sdk/agui targets AG-UI 1.0 via AG-UI community Go SDK
EventAdapter runs one turn as one run; event mapping table
TOOL_CALL_ARGS emitted per call (published without the 'when it has arguments' condition)
Tool-then-answer turn yields two assistant messages in one run
TOOL_CALL_RESULT never empty: error, media description, or JSON encoding (null when none)
Frontend tool call ends the run unanswered; answered in next run's input; RunResume continues
OnToolAsync holds a call; interrupt outcome; ResolveTool/RejectTool then RunContinue reports the approved tool's result
Adapter never drops events; waits for consumer; ctx cancel releases
Events buffer of 64; code that lets RunSend finish before reading blocks
Adapter does not stream tokens; one TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT per message
RUN_FINISHED names no pending frontend calls
Converters mint a new message id each conversion
Only the new input is passed to the conversation; client-edited history not reflected
HttpAgent from @ag-ui/client example
Linked pages exist: sdk/reference/ag-ui, sdk/tutorials/11-ag-ui-integration, concepts/a2a
